desc: Ideation complete: Understanded that the problem reduces to finding the maximum y-intercept of lines connecting $(0, h)$ to $(X_i, H_i)$ that are blocked by some previous building $j$. This is equivalent to finding $\max_{i} (\max_{j < i} \frac{H_j X_i - H_i X_j}{X_i - X_j})$.
Implement the upper convex hull maintenance (monotonic chain) for points added sequentially.

Implement the tangent query: for a new point, find the point on the current upper convex hull that maximizes the y-intercept of the connecting line. Use binary search or a pointer since the hull is sorted by X.
Iterate through all buildings, updating the hull and tracking the maximum required height $R_i$.
Handle the output logic: if max height <= 0, print -1, else print the max height.
Test with provided samples to ensure correctness.
